title: Mishlove meets Puharich at Berkeley conference
summary: Jeffrey Mishlove tells of Mishlove meets Puharich at Berkeley conference, about 1972 at Zellerbach Auditorium, Berkeley, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Puharic uh when I first met him was about 1972 and at Berkeley I sponsored a conference at in Zelerbach auditorium.
